claim_scope: N64 GBI/Fast3D official microcode is proprietary; libdragon provides an open-source SDK replacement (Unlicense) with its own RSP ucodes, rspq command queue, and open-source IPL3 bootcode
notes: Verified against libdragon.dev, the N64brew wiki, and the DragonMinded/libdragon repository. Community consensus and vendor posture both treat the original microcode/libultra as proprietary; clean-room paths are complete enough to ship commercial-quality homebrew.
title: N64 microcode family and clean-room lineage
